figures.description: Single Axle, Dual Tire Load, 18,000 lb (the base ESAL). Digitized in tables.figure_f1_rigid_thickness: k-family (7 lines) fit by connected-component pixel regression; N-family (8 lines) modeled as log-linear interpolation between two exact Appendix G anchors (G-7: flexural=650/k=100/passes=20e6 -> 8.1in; G-8.11: flexural=650/k=325/passes=1.2e6 -> 6.3in). See the module docstring for the fuller digitization discipline, including a documented failed attempt to densify the N-family beyond the two anchors (line-identity could not be verified).

figures.caption: Passenger Car Plain Concrete and RCCP
figures.description: NOT digitized (chart_read function does not exist -- catalog/vision-read only). Passenger Car, 3,000 lb. Appendix G gives one real anchor at flexural=750 psi, k=147 psi/in (Subgrade Category C): passes=21,900,000 -> thickness=2.6 in (Table G-3). Independent full digitization (own axis calibration + k-family trace, confirmed NOT reusable from Figure F-1 -- e.g. this chart's thickness axis range differs from F-1's 4-12in) was judged out of scope for this pass; these anchor point(s) are exact (text-extracted from the guide, no chart-reading involved) and usable as a spot-check for any future digitization or an independent design-equation implementation.

figures.caption: M1A2 Main Tank Tracked Plain Concrete and RCCP
figures.description: NOT digitized (chart_read function does not exist -- catalog/vision-read only). M1A2 Main Tank, 139,000 lb. Appendix G gives TWO real anchors at flexural=750 psi, k=147 psi/in (Subgrade Category C): passes=147,295 -> thickness=7.8 in (G-5.1, pdf_page 280-281, printed 261); passes=365,444 -> thickness=8.3 in (G-5.2, pdf_page 282-283, printed 263). This is the ONLY vehicle-specific figure with more than one exact anchor. A full independent digitization attempt was started (axis-gridline calibration confirmed: flexural gridlines match F-1's row-spacing closely, but the THICKNESS axis is 4-16 in here, not F-1's 4-12 in, requiring its own re-derivation) but not completed in this pass given the per-chart scope (comparable to Figure F-1's full build); the two exact anchors above are usable as-is for validation.
